signs.name: HELLO
signs.title: Like a salute
signs.how: Flat hand, fingers together. Start at the side of your forehead and move it out and away from you.

signs.name: NO
signs.title: Fingers snap shut
signs.how: Hold up your index and middle fingers with your thumb, then snap them closed onto the thumb. Once or twice.

signs.name: THANK-YOU
signs.title: From your chin, outward
signs.how: Flat hand, fingertips at your chin. Move the hand forward and down toward the person you're thanking.

signs.name: YES
signs.title: A nodding fist
signs.how: Make a fist and bob it up and down at the wrist, like a head nodding yes.
